_note: womenperfume (blibli/shopee/lazada/tokopedia/tiktok ID) writes to the shared `cologne` dataset, exactly like menperfume and unisexperfume: cologne.product_id_dict_qa / cologne.cologne_dict / cologne.filter_cologne. cologne_dict columns are brand, sku_type_complete, user_category, keywords, keyword_typo, bundle_type, bundle_quantity -- there is NO _meta column on the dict table, so the harness's 'stamp _meta on the dict insert' step cannot be honoured. sku_type_complete is a BASE column (typed directly, brand-first), not composed from sub_brand/variant/packsize columns. Inferred 2026-09-09 on the Blibli/ID Tier-1 run; identical to dict_patterns/unisexperfume.json because it is literally the same dict table.
_keyword_typo: Optional. '' (never NULL) on the vast majority of rows. When non-empty it holds a common misspelling of the identity.

_sku_type_complete.size_format: '100 ml' (space before unit); multipack suffix ' x N pcs'; unknown variant -> 'Multi Variant'; unknown size -> 'Multi Size'
_sku_type_complete.concentration_is_per_line: Copy the line's existing token, not the pack's printed one: Vitalis Sparkle prints EAU DE PARFUM but the dict says EDT; Perfume Republic prints EDP but the dict says EDT; Secret Garden prints Extrait de Parfum but the dict says EDP.
_sku_type_complete.bundles: Multi-FRAGRANCE packs that NAME their components enumerate them with ' + ' (brand once, at the front) and keep the ' x N pcs' suffix, bundle_type='multipack', bundle_quantity=N. Mixed-FORM bundles (fragrance + face wash / pomade / roll-on) enumerate with ' + ' but are typed bundle_type='single', bundle_quantity=1.0 with NO ' x N pcs'. Pick-your-own packs -> 'Multi Variant' (+ 'Multi Size').
_sku_type_complete.promo_vs_pack: A promo mechanic in the title (BUY 2 GET 1, beli 1 gratis 1, [Paket isi N] on a single named variant) maps to the SINGLE-unit variant row, not an ' x N pcs' row. Human precedent on Vitalis: [Paket isi 2/3] <named variant> -> the variant row; only the Eau de Joie/Sparkle 100 ml isi-3/6 packs collapse to 'Vitalis Multi Variant EDP 100 ml'. Blibli 'Twinpack' Sparkle titles also go to the single variant row (human 4:1).

_attribute_vocab._user_category_note: Legacy-noisy. Default to 'Women' on this dataset unless the pack is explicitly a men's/boys' product; do not add to 'Unisex'.
_attribute_vocab.bundle_quantity: FLOAT64; 1.0 for single, N for multipack
